title: Voxelgame features and wiki coverage
description: Base-game features, controls and guide coverage for Voxelgame, with status and source evidence for the audited commit.
headline:
What’s in the game,
and how to learn it.
lead: The base-game systems and controls at the audited commit. Each entry records what is available, what is limited and where to find a written guide.
legendLead: Each feature has exactly one status for the audited game version. Creative and survival differences are noted on the feature. A planned feature is never described as playable here, even when work on it has started.
gapsLead: Practical, task-based guides ranked by how many players need them and whether the feature is ready to document. Each guide will be checked in a disposable headless game session before it is published.
docNotesLead: The audit compared the game’s own README and documents with its code. Where they disagree, this ledger follows the code, and the mismatch is listed here for the game’s maintainers.

features.name: Creative and survival modes (F4)
features.summary: There are exactly two modes. Press F4 any time to switch between creative and survival; your pack, hotbar and position stay as they are. New worlds always start in creative, and each world remembers the mode it was saved in.
controls: Switch creative / survival (in the world (refused while connected to a server))

crates/voxelgame-core/src/game.rs:592 — new sessions start in creative
src/app.rs:540-558 — Create world copies settings and packs but has no mode choice
features.notes: Creative: instant breaking and free placing, free crafting, any tool and unlimited ammunition, the Build tab and catalog, building brushes and undo, middle-click block picking, flight, map travel and teleport, editable time/weather/season, one-hit animal removal without drops. Survival: timed mining with tool advice, carry capacity, health/hunger/thirst/stamina/temperature with HUD bars, fall damage, R eat / T drink / X quick craft, World tab read-only, respawn at your rest point. No hardcore, peaceful or difficulty settings exist (grep found none).

features.name: Keyboard, mouse and controller support
features.summary: The game is played with keyboard and mouse only: there is no gamepad support and keys cannot be rebound. Keys are read by physical position, so on non-QWERTY keyboards use the keys where W A S D sit on a QWERTY board.
evidence: src/input_adapter.rs:18-23 — fixed mapping from physical key codes

features.notes: Known Linux issue: an active Pinyin input method on X11 can swallow movement keys (unresolved). Because key repeat is ignored, holding Backspace deletes one character; Ctrl+Backspace clears the Worlds search and map coordinate fields. Non-ASCII characters are dropped from names and searches (chat accepts printable ASCII). Known issue: on X11, a Pinyin input method can swallow movement keys; a reliable fix is not verified yet (game TODO.md).

method.title: Source, not memory
method.text: The audit read an exact export of the audited commit: input handling, menus, crafting, survival, building, world, maps, sailing, combat, platform and settings code. Every feature cites at least one file and line, and the game’s own documents were checked against that code.

method.title: Planned means absent
method.text: Tracked requests were searched for in the same export. Anything missing, or present only as code that ordinary players cannot reach, is marked Planned or In development, never Available.

method.title: Not yet a play test
method.text: This ledger records what the code supports. Practical guides add controls and screenshots verified in disposable headless sessions, never a visible game window or a normal player save.

method.title: Numbers come from the code
method.text: Capacities, ranges, timings and recipe amounts are copied from the constants that define them. When a later game change moves them, the next audit updates this page and its commit.
